title: Parts delayed
summary: Induction module out of stock. Lead time pushes the earliest viable slot.
expected: Recommendation B (repair). check_inventory shows zero stock and a 9-day lead time; send_ops_message requests the order; the proposed slot is on or after today + 9 days.

issue.description: One hob zone not working. Resident reports the front-left ring does not respond.

resident_persona.name: Leila Haddad
resident_persona.ground_truth: The front-left induction zone does not detect pans at all - no beep, no heat, display shows nothing for that zone. The other three zones work perfectly. She has tried different pans including ones that work on the other zones.
resident_persona.behaviour: Clear and helpful, gives precise answers. Has already ruled out the pan being the problem and will say so. Cooks a lot so she is keen to know how long it will take.
